definitions.explanation: An intuitive sense beyond the five physical senses — the ability to perceive or know something without conscious reasoning. Similar to English 'sixth sense.'

examples.japanese: {第六感|だいろっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{第六感|だいろっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a person with keen intuition.

examples.japanese: {第六感|だいろっかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こり→起こる：01910_okoru⟧そうな⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧がした。
examples.english: My gut feeling told me something bad was about to happen.

notes:
USAGE:
Used the same way as "sixth sense" in English. Often appears with ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work, to kick in) or ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ (sharp, keen).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {第六感|だいろっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (one's sixth sense kicks in)
- {第六感|だいろっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ (to have keen intuition)
- {第六感|だいろっかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to sense with one's sixth sense)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{直感|ちょっかん}→直感：07624_chokkan⟧ (intuition — more commonly used in everyday speech)
- ⟦{勘|かん}→勘：02149_kan⟧ (intuition, hunch — more casual)
